shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace/app && echo "---PKG---" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "---CLAUDE---" && cat /workspace/CLAUDE.md && echo "---GEMINI---" && cat /workspace/GEMINI.md
ls -la /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no docs dir"; echo "---NEXT VERSION---"; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd /workspace && grep -rn "connection" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/reject.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i connection | head -20; echo "---types---"; grep -rn "export.*connection" node_modules/next/types/index.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -i "connection" | head -20

cd /workspace && (npm run start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6 ; echo "=== Request 1 ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000 | grep -o '<time[^>]*>[^<]*</time>' ; sleep 2 ; echo "=== Request 2 ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000 | grep -o '<time[^>]*>[^<]*</time>' ; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; true
